Farm.title: Farm
Farm.description: Single-player farm save state owned by one authenticated Google user.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the save document (currently 1).

revision.description: Monotonically increasing revision counter for optimistic concurrency control.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the farm owner.

seeds.description: Map of cropId to non-negative seed counts (wheat, carrot).

crops.description: Map of cropId to non-negative harvested crop counts (wheat, carrot).

plots.description: Fixed array of 6 farm plots with cropId, plantedAt, and wateredAt timestamps.

stats.description: Cumulative counters: totalPlanted, totalHarvested, totalRevenue, rescueGrants.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the farm was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest confirmed save.

/farms/{userId}.description: Per-user isolated farm save document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
